hypothesis: Add a per-row "user historical long_view rate" feature — for each impression, the smoothed rate of the user's own long_view outcomes over strictly prior (time-ordered) impressions only, bucketized into deciles — as a new categorical FM field. This is the legitimate aggregated-historical-outcome pattern explicitly allowed by the leakage rule, and unlike last iteration's static demographic fields (which added many high-cardinality categories and overfit by epoch 4), this is a single low-cardinality (10-bucket) field carrying strong, genuinely time-safe personalization signal that should generalize better.
expected_effect: GAUC should move more than nDCG@5, since this feature's main value is letting FM's pairwise interactions modulate video/tab scoring differently for behaviorally distinct user segments (chronically-high vs chronically-low long-view users), which sharpens within-user relative ranking — the exact quantity GAUC measures — more than it shifts the cross-user absolute score calibration that nDCG@5's top-of-list selection depends on.
